Messages.Author: Steve Wedd
Messages.Body:
I have a question about the ravnos Master 'Week of Nightmares'.

Card text :

Place 10 counters on this card. During each methuselahs master phase,
he may put a counter from this card onto a Ravnos in play. Burn this
card when there are no more counters on it. Whilst this card is in
play, all ravnos have +1 bleed and +1 strength. When this card is
burned, each Ravnos with a WOM counter on it must burn a blood to
remove a counter or burn. Only one week of nightmares can be played
in a game.

This states that each Methuselah "may" place a nightmare counter on
a Ravnos in play. Can I just get clarification whether this is
optional or not?

I expect that card text is correct and it is optional, Im only asking
because I have just discovered that it really owns in a 1v1 (I was on
the receiving end - 20 turns of nightmares - ouch).

Come to think of it, it also might open doors to some really sleazy deals...
"Hey, if you don't put a Nightmare counter on me, I'll..."

Thanks.

I don't know who typed this in, but it's apparently done from memory.

It costs no pool.

Card text:

Put this card in play and place 10 nightmare counters on it. During each Methuselah's untap phase, he or she may move a nightmare counter from this card to a Ravnos. When the last counter is moved, each Ravnos must burn a blood for each nightmare counter or be burned, and this card and all nightmare counters are then burned. While this card is in play, all Ravnos get +1 bleed and +1 strength and do not hunt as normal. Any ready Ravnos may hunt by stealing a blood from any other Ravnos as a +1 stealth (D) action. Only one Week of Nightmares may be played during a game.
